translations.kjv: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
translations.ylt: The former account, indeed, I made concerning all things, O Theophilus, that Jesus began both to do and to teach,
translations.web: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

translations.kjv: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
translations.ylt: till the day in which, having given command, through the Holy Spirit, to the apostles whom he did choose out, he was taken up,
translations.web: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

translations.kjv: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
translations.ylt: to whom also he did present himself alive after his suffering, in many certain proofs, through forty days being seen by them, and speaking the things concerning the reign of God.
translations.web: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

translations.kjv: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
translations.ylt: And being assembled together with them, he commanded them not to depart from Jerusalem, but to wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, `Ye did hear of me;
translations.web: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

translations.kjv: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
translations.ylt: because John, indeed, baptized with water, and ye shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit--after not many days.'
translations.web: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

translations.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
translations.ylt: They, therefore, indeed, having come together, were questioning him, saying, `Lord, dost thou at this time restore the reign to Israel?'
translations.web: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
translations.ylt: and he said unto them, `It is not yours to know times or seasons that the Father did appoint in His own authority;
translations.web: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

translations.kjv: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
translations.ylt: but ye shall receive power at the coming of the Holy Spirit upon you, and ye shall be witnesses to me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judea, and Samaria, and unto the end of the earth.'
translations.web: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

translations.kjv: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
translations.ylt: And these things having said--they beholding--he was taken up, and a cloud did receive him up from their sight;
translations.web: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

translations.kjv: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
translations.ylt: and as they were looking stedfastly to the heaven in his going on, then, lo, two men stood by them in white apparel,
translations.web: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

translations.kjv: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
translations.ylt: who also said, `Men, Galileans, why do ye stand gazing into the heaven? this Jesus who was received up from you into the heaven, shall so come in what manner ye saw him going on to the heaven.'
translations.web: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

translations.kjv: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
translations.ylt: Then did they return to Jerusalem from the mount that is called of Olives, that is near Jerusalem, a sabbath's journey;
translations.web: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

translations.kjv: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alpheus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
translations.ylt: and when they came in, they went up to the upper room, where were abiding both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James, of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zelotes, and Judas, of James;
translations.web: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

translations.kjv: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
translations.ylt: these all were continuing with one accord in prayer and supplication, with women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
translations.web: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

translations.kjv: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
translations.ylt: And in these days, Peter having risen up in the midst of the disciples, said, (the multitude also of the names at the same place was, as it were, an hundred and twenty,)
translations.web: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

translations.kjv: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
translations.ylt: `Men, brethren, it behoved this Writing that it be fulfilled that beforehand the Holy Spirit spake through the mouth of David, concerning Judas, who became guide to those who took Jesus,
translations.web: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

translations.kjv: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
translations.ylt: because he was numbered among us, and did receive the share in this ministration,
translations.web: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

translations.kjv: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
translations.ylt: this one, indeed, then, purchased a field out of the reward of unrighteousness, and falling headlong, burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed forth,
translations.web: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

translations.kjv: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
translations.ylt: and it became known to all those dwelling in Jerusalem, insomuch that that place is called, in their proper dialect, Aceldama, that is, field of blood,
translations.web: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

translations.kjv: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
translations.ylt: for it hath been written in the book of Psalms: Let his lodging-place become desolate, and let no one be dwelling in it, and his oversight let another take.
translations.web: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

translations.kjv: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
translations.ylt: `It behoveth, therefore, of the men who did go with us during all the time in which the Lord Jesus went in and went out among us,
translations.web: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

translations.kjv: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
translations.ylt: beginning from the baptism of John, unto the day in which he was received up from us, one of these to become with us a witness of his rising again.'
translations.web: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

translations.kjv: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
translations.ylt: And they set two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias,
translations.web: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

translations.kjv: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
translations.ylt: and having prayed, they said, `Thou, Lord, who art knowing the heart of all, shew which one thou didst choose of these two
translations.web: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

translations.kjv: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
translations.ylt: to receive the share of this ministration and apostleship, from which Judas, by transgression, did fall, to go on to his proper place;'
translations.web: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

translations.kjv: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
translations.ylt: and they gave their lots, and the lot fell upon Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
translations.web: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

translations.kjv: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
translations.ylt: And in the day of the Pentecost being fulfilled, they were all with one accord at the same place,
translations.web: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

translations.kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
translations.ylt: and there came suddenly out of the heaven a sound as of a bearing violent breath, and it filled all the house where they were sitting,
translations.web: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

translations.kjv: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
translations.ylt: and there appeared to them divided tongues, as it were of fire; it sat also upon each one of them,
translations.web: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

translations.kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
translations.ylt: and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other tongues, according as the Spirit was giving them to declare.
translations.web: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

translations.kjv: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
translations.ylt: And there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men from every nation of those under the heaven,
translations.web: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

translations.kjv: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
translations.ylt: and the rumour of this having come, the multitude came together, and was confounded, because they were each one hearing them speaking in his proper dialect,
translations.web: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galileans?
translations.ylt: and they were all amazed, and did wonder, saying one unto another, `Lo, are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
translations.web: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

translations.kjv: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
translations.ylt: and how do we hear, each in our proper dialect, in which we were born?
translations.web: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

translations.kjv: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
translations.ylt: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and those dwelling in Mesopotamia, in Judea also, and Cappadocia, Pontus, and Asia,
translations.web: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

translations.kjv: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
translations.ylt: Phrygia also, and Pamphylia, Egypt, and the parts of Libya, that are along Cyrene, and the strangers of Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
translations.web: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

translations.kjv: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
translations.ylt: Cretes and Arabians, we did hear them speaking in our tongues the great things of God.'
translations.web: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
translations.ylt: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one unto another, `What would this wish to be?'
translations.web: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

translations.kjv: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
translations.ylt: and others mocking said, --`They are full of sweet wine;'
translations.web: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

translations.kjv: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
translations.ylt: and Peter having stood up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and declared to them, `Men, Jews! and all those dwelling in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and harken to my sayings,
translations.web: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

translations.kjv: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
translations.ylt: for these are not drunken, as ye take it up, for it is the third hour of the day.
translations.web: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

translations.kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
translations.ylt: `But this is that which hath been spoken through the prophet Joel:
translations.web: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
translations.ylt: And it shall be in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of My Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams;
translations.web: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

translations.kjv: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
translations.ylt: and also upon My men-servants, and upon My maid-servants, in those days, I will pour out of My Spirit, and they shall prophesy;
translations.web: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

translations.kjv: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
translations.ylt: and I will give wonders in the heaven above, and signs upon the earth beneath--blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke,
translations.web: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

translations.kjv: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
translations.ylt: the sun shall be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the day of the Lord--the great and illustrious;
translations.web: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
translations.ylt: and it shall be, every one--whoever shall call upon the name of the Lord, he shall be saved.
translations.web: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

translations.kjv: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
translations.ylt: `Men, Israelites! hear these words, Jesus the Nazarene, a man approved of God among you by mighty works, and wonders, and signs, that God did through him in the midst of you, according as also ye yourselves have known;
translations.web: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

translations.kjv: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
translations.ylt: this one, by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, being given out, having taken by lawless hands, having crucified--ye did slay;
translations.web: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

translations.kjv: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
translations.ylt: whom God did raise up, having loosed the pains of the death, because it was not possible for him to be held by it,
translations.web: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

translations.kjv: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
translations.ylt: for David saith in regard to him: I foresaw the Lord always before me--because He is on my right hand--that I may not be moved;
translations.web: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

translations.kjv: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
translations.ylt: because of this was my heart cheered, and my tongue was glad, and yet--my flesh also shall rest on hope,
translations.web: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

translations.kjv: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
translations.ylt: because Thou wilt not leave my soul to hades, nor wilt Thou give Thy Kind One to see corruption;
translations.web: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

translations.kjv: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
translations.ylt: Thou didst make known to me ways of life, Thou shalt fill me with joy with Thy countenance.
translations.web: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

translations.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
translations.ylt: `Men, brethren! it is permitted to speak with freedom unto you concerning the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is among us unto this day;
translations.web: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

translations.kjv: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
translations.ylt: a prophet, therefore, being, and knowing that with an oath God did swear to him, out of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, to raise up the Christ, to sit upon his throne,
translations.web: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

translations.kjv: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
translations.ylt: having foreseen, he did speak concerning the rising again of the Christ, that his soul was not left to hades, nor did his flesh see corruption.
translations.web: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

translations.kjv: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
translations.ylt: `This Jesus did God raise up, of which we are all witnesses;
translations.web: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

translations.kjv: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
translations.ylt: at the right hand then of God having been exalted--also the promise of the Holy Spirit having received from the Father--he was shedding forth this, which now ye see and hear;
translations.web: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

translations.kjv: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
translations.ylt: for David did not go up to the heavens, and he saith himself: The Lord saith to my lord, Sit thou at my right hand,
translations.web: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

translations.kjv: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
translations.ylt: till I make thy foes thy footstool;
translations.web: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

translations.kjv: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
translations.ylt: assuredly, therefore, let all the house of Israel know, that both Lord and Christ did God make him--this Jesus whom ye did crucify.'
translations.web: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

translations.kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
translations.ylt: And having heard, they were pricked to the heart; they say also to Peter, and to the rest of the apostles, `What shall we do, men, brethren?'
translations.web: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

translations.kjv: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and Peter said unto them, `Reform, and be baptized each of you on the name of Jesus Christ, to remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit,
translations.web: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
translations.ylt: for to you is the promise, and to your children, and to all those afar off, as many as the Lord our God shall call.'
translations.web: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

translations.kjv: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
translations.ylt: Also with many more other words he was testifying and exhorting, saying, `Be saved from this perverse generation;'
translations.web: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

translations.kjv: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
translations.ylt: then those, indeed, who did gladly receive his word were baptized, and there were added on that day, as it were, three thousand souls,
translations.web: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

translations.kjv: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
translations.ylt: and they were continuing stedfastly in the teaching of the apostles, and the fellowship, and the breaking of the bread, and the prayers.
translations.web: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

translations.kjv: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
translations.ylt: And fear came on every soul, many wonders also and signs were being done through the apostles,
translations.web: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

translations.kjv: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
translations.ylt: and all those believing were at the same place, and had all things common,
translations.web: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

translations.kjv: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
translations.ylt: and the possessions and the goods they were selling, and were parting them to all, according as any one had need.
translations.web: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

translations.kjv: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
translations.ylt: Daily also continuing with one accord in the temple, breaking also at every house bread, they were partaking of food in gladness and simplicity of heart,
translations.web: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

translations.kjv: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
translations.ylt: praising God, and having favour with all the people, and the Lord was adding those being saved every day to the assembly.
translations.web: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

translations.kjv: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
translations.ylt: And Peter and John were going up at the same time to the temple, at the hour of the prayer, the ninth hour,
translations.web: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

translations.kjv: And a certain man lame from his mother’s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
translations.ylt: and a certain man, being lame from the womb of his mother, was being carried, whom they were laying every day at the gate of the temple, called Beautiful, to ask a kindness from those entering into the temple,
translations.web: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

translations.kjv: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
translations.ylt: who, having seen Peter and John about to go into the temple, was begging to receive a kindness.
translations.web: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

translations.kjv: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
translations.ylt: And Peter, having looked stedfastly toward him with John, said, `Look toward us;'
translations.web: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

translations.kjv: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
translations.ylt: and he was giving heed to them, looking to receive something from them;
translations.web: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

translations.kjv: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
translations.ylt: and Peter said, `Silver and gold I have none, but what I have, that I give to thee; in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and be walking.'
translations.web: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

translations.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
translations.ylt: And having seized him by the right hand, he raised him up, and presently his feet and ankles were strengthened,
translations.web: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

translations.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
translations.ylt: and springing up, he stood, and was walking, and did enter with them into the temple, walking and springing, and praising God;
translations.web: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

translations.kjv: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
translations.ylt: and all the people saw him walking and praising God,
translations.web: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

translations.kjv: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
translations.ylt: they were knowing him also that this it was who for a kindness was sitting at the Beautiful gate of the temple, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what hath happened to him.
translations.web: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

translations.kjv: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
translations.ylt: And at the lame man who was healed holding Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch called Solomon's--greatly amazed,
translations.web: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

translations.kjv: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
translations.ylt: and Peter having seen, answered unto the people, `Men, Israelites! why wonder ye at this? or on us why look ye so earnestly, as if by our own power or piety we have made him to walk?
translations.web: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

translations.kjv: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
translations.ylt: `The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, did glorify His child Jesus, whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, he having given judgment to release him,
translations.web: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

translations.kjv: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
translations.ylt: and ye the Holy and Righteous One did deny, and desired a man--a murderer--to be granted to you,
translations.web: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

translations.kjv: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
translations.ylt: and the Prince of the life ye did kill, whom God did raise out of the dead, of which we are witnesses;
translations.web: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

translations.kjv: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
translations.ylt: and on the faith of his name, this one whom ye see and have known, his name made strong, even the faith that is through him did give to him this perfect soundness before you all.
translations.web: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

translations.kjv: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
translations.ylt: `And now, brethren, I have known that through ignorance ye did it, as also your rulers;
translations.web: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

translations.kjv: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
translations.ylt: and God, what things before He had declared through the mouth of all His prophets, that the Christ should suffer, He did thus fulfil;
translations.web: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

translations.kjv: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
translations.ylt: reform ye, therefore, and turn back, for your sins being blotted out, that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord,
translations.web: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

translations.kjv: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
translations.ylt: and He may send Jesus Christ who before hath been preached to you,
translations.web: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

translations.kjv: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
translations.ylt: whom it behoveth heaven, indeed, to receive till times of a restitution of all things, of which God spake through the mouth of all His holy prophets from the age.
translations.web: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

translations.kjv: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
translations.ylt: `For Moses, indeed, unto the fathers said--A prophet to you shall the Lord your God raise up out of your brethren, like to me; him shall ye hear in all things, as many as he may speak unto you;
translations.web: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
translations.ylt: and it shall be, every soul that may not hear that prophet shall be utterly destroyed out of the people;
translations.web: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

translations.kjv: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
translations.ylt: and also all the prophets from Samuel and those following in order, as many as spake, did also foretell of these days.
translations.web: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

translations.kjv: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
translations.ylt: `Ye are sons of the prophets, and of the covenant that God made unto our fathers, saying unto Abraham: And in thy seed shall be blessed all the families of the earth;
translations.web: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

translations.kjv: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
translations.ylt: to you first, God, having raised up His child Jesus, did send him, blessing you, in the turning away of each one from your evil ways.'
translations.web: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

translations.kjv: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
translations.ylt: And as they are speaking unto the people, there came to them the priests, and the magistrate of the temple, and the Sadducees--
translations.web: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

translations.kjv: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
translations.ylt: being grieved because of their teaching the people, and preaching in Jesus the rising again out of the dead--
translations.web: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

translations.kjv: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
translations.ylt: and they laid hands upon them, and did put them in custody unto the morrow, for it was evening already;
translations.web: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

translations.kjv: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
translations.ylt: and many of those hearing the word did believe, and the number of the men became, as it were, five thousand.
translations.web: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
translations.ylt: And it came to pass upon the morrow, there were gathered together of them the rulers, and elders, and scribes, to Jerusalem,
translations.web: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: and Annas the chief priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the chief priest,
translations.web: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

translations.kjv: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
translations.ylt: and having set them in the midst, they were inquiring, `In what power, or in what name did ye do this?'
translations.web: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

translations.kjv: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
translations.ylt: Then Peter, having been filled with the Holy Spirit, said unto them: `Rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
translations.web: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

translations.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
translations.ylt: if we to-day are examined concerning the good deed to the ailing man, by whom he hath been saved,
translations.web: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

translations.kjv: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
translations.ylt: be it known to all of you, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye did crucify, whom God did raise out of the dead, in him hath this one stood by before you whole.
translations.web: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

translations.kjv: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
translations.ylt: `This is the stone that was set at nought by you--the builders, that became head of a corner;
translations.web: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

translations.kjv: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
translations.ylt: and there is not salvation in any other, for there is no other name under the heaven that hath been given among men, in which it behoveth us to be saved.'
translations.web: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

translations.kjv: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
translations.ylt: And beholding the openness of Peter and John, and having perceived that they are men unlettered and plebeian, they were wondering--they were taking knowledge also of them that with Jesus they had been--
translations.web: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

translations.kjv: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
translations.ylt: and seeing the man standing with them who hath been healed, they had nothing to say against it,
translations.web: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

translations.kjv: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
translations.ylt: and having commanded them to go away out of the sanhedrim, they took counsel with one another,
translations.web: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

translations.kjv: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
translations.ylt: saying, `What shall we do to these men? because that, indeed, a notable sign hath been done through them, to all those dwelling in Jerusalem is manifest, and we are not able to deny it;
translations.web: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

translations.kjv: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
translations.ylt: but that it may spread no further toward the people, let us strictly threaten them no more to speak in this name to any man.'
translations.web: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

translations.kjv: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
translations.ylt: And having called them, they charged them not to speak at all, nor to teach, in the name of Jesus,
translations.web: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

translations.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
translations.ylt: and Peter and John answering unto them said, `Whether it is righteous before God to hearken to you rather than to God, judge ye;
translations.web: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

translations.kjv: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
translations.ylt: for we cannot but speak what we did see and hear.'
translations.web: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

translations.kjv: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
translations.ylt: And they having further threatened them, let them go, finding nothing how they may punish them, because of the people, because all were glorifying God for that which hath been done,
translations.web: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

translations.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
translations.ylt: for above forty years of age was the man upon whom had been done this sign of the healing.
translations.web: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

translations.kjv: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
translations.ylt: And being let go, they went unto their own friends, and declared whatever the chief priests and the elders said unto them,
translations.web: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

translations.kjv: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
translations.ylt: and they having heard, with one accord did lift up the voice unto God, and said, `Lord, thou art God, who didst make the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and all that are in them,
translations.web: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

translations.kjv: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
translations.ylt: who, through the mouth of David thy servant, did say, Why did nations rage, and peoples meditate vain things?
translations.web: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

translations.kjv: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
translations.ylt: the kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord and against His Christ;
translations.web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

translations.kjv: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
translations.ylt: for gathered together of a truth against Thy holy child Jesus, whom Thou didst anoint, were both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with nations and peoples of Israel,
translations.web: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

translations.kjv: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
translations.ylt: to do whatever Thy hand and Thy counsel did determine before to come to pass.
translations.web: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

translations.kjv: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
translations.ylt: `And now, Lord, look upon their threatenings, and grant to Thy servants with all freedom to speak Thy word,
translations.web: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

translations.kjv: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
translations.ylt: in the stretching forth of Thy hand, for healing, and signs, and wonders, to come to pass through the name of Thy holy child Jesus.'
translations.web: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

translations.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
translations.ylt: And they having prayed, the place was shaken in which they were gathered together, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and were speaking the word of God with freedom,
translations.web: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

translations.kjv: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
translations.ylt: and of the multitude of those who did believe the heart and the soul was one, and not one was saying that anything of the things he had was his own, but all things were to them in common.
translations.web: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

translations.kjv: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
translations.ylt: And with great power were the apostles giving the testimony to the rising again of the Lord Jesus, great grace also was on them all,
translations.web: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

translations.kjv: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
translations.ylt: for there was not any one among them who did lack, for as many as were possessors of fields, or houses, selling them, were bringing the prices of the thing sold,
translations.web: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

translations.kjv: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
translations.ylt: and were laying them at the feet of the apostles, and distribution was being made to each according as any one had need.
translations.web: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

translations.kjv: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
translations.ylt: And Joses, who was surnamed by the apostles Barnabas--which is, having been interpreted, Son of Comfort--a Levite, of Cyprus by birth,
translations.web: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

translations.kjv: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
translations.ylt: a field being his, having sold it, brought the money and laid it at the feet of the apostles.
translations.web: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

translations.kjv: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
translations.ylt: And a certain man, Ananias by name, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
translations.web: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

translations.kjv: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
translations.ylt: and did keep back of the price--his wife also knowing--and having brought a certain part, at the feet of the apostles he laid it.
translations.web: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

translations.kjv: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
translations.ylt: And Peter said, `Ananias, wherefore did the Adversary fill thy heart, for thee to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back of the price of the place?
translations.web: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

translations.kjv: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
translations.ylt: while it remained, did it not remain thine? and having been sold, in thy authority was it not? why is it that thou didst put in thy heart this thing? thou didst not lie to men, but to God;'
translations.web: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

translations.kjv: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
translations.ylt: and Ananias hearing these words, having fallen down, did expire, and great fear came upon all who heard these things,
translations.web: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

translations.kjv: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
translations.ylt: and having risen, the younger men wound him up, and having carried forth, they buried him.
translations.web: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

translations.kjv: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass, about three hours after, that his wife, not knowing what hath happened, came in,
translations.web: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

translations.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
translations.ylt: and Peter answered her, `Tell me if for so much ye sold the place;' and she said, `Yes, for so much.'
translations.web: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
translations.ylt: And Peter said unto her, `How was it agreed by you, to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? lo, the feet of those who did bury thy husband are at the door, and they shall carry thee forth;'
translations.web: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

translations.kjv: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
translations.ylt: and she fell down presently at his feet, and expired, and the young men having come in, found her dead, and having carried forth, they buried her by her husband;
translations.web: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

translations.kjv: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
translations.ylt: and great fear came upon all the assembly, and upon all who heard these things.
translations.web: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

translations.kjv: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
translations.ylt: And through the hands of the apostles came many signs and wonders among the people, and they were with one accord all in the porch of Solomon;
translations.web: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

translations.kjv: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
translations.ylt: and of the rest no one was daring to join himself to them, but the people were magnifying them,
translations.web: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

translations.kjv: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
translations.ylt: (and the more were believers added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women,)
translations.web: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

translations.kjv: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
translations.ylt: so as into the broad places to bring forth the ailing, and to lay them upon couches and mats, that at the coming of Peter, even his shadow might overshadow some one of them;
translations.web: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

translations.kjv: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
translations.ylt: and there were coming together also the people of the cities round about to Jerusalem, bearing ailing persons, and those harassed by unclean spirits--who were all healed.
translations.web: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

translations.kjv: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
translations.ylt: And having risen, the chief priest, and all those with him--being the sect of the Sadducees--were filled with zeal,
translations.web: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

translations.kjv: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
translations.ylt: and laid their hands upon the apostles, and did put them in a public prison;
translations.web: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

translations.kjv: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
translations.ylt: and a messenger of the Lord through the night opened the doors of the prison, having also brought them forth, he said,
translations.web: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

translations.kjv: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
translations.ylt: `Go on, and standing, speak in the temple to the people all the sayings of this life;'
translations.web: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

translations.kjv: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
translations.ylt: and having heard, they did enter at the dawn into the temple, and were teaching. And the chief priest having come, and those with him, they called together the sanhedrim and all the senate of the sons of Israel, and they sent to the prison to have them brought,
translations.web: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

translations.kjv: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
translations.ylt: and the officers having come, did not find them in the prison, and having turned back, they told,
translations.web: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

translations.kjv: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
translations.ylt: saying--`The prison indeed we found shut in all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors, and having opened--within we found no one.'
translations.web: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

translations.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
translations.ylt: And as the priest, and the magistrate of the temple, and the chief priests, heard these words, they were doubting concerning them to what this would come;
translations.web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

translations.kjv: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
translations.ylt: and coming near, a certain one told them, saying--`Lo, the men whom ye did put in the prison are in the temple standing and teaching the people;'
translations.web: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

translations.kjv: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
translations.ylt: then the magistrate having gone away with officers, brought them without violence, for they were fearing the people, lest they should be stoned;
translations.web: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

translations.kjv: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
translations.ylt: and having brought them, they set them in the sanhedrim, and the chief priest questioned them,
translations.web: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

translations.kjv: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.
translations.ylt: saying, `Did not we strictly command you not to teach in this name? and lo, ye have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and ye intend to bring upon us the blood of this man.'
translations.web: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
translations.ylt: And Peter and the apostles answering, said, `To obey God it behoveth, rather than men;
translations.web: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

translations.kjv: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
translations.ylt: and the God of our fathers did raise up Jesus, whom ye slew, having hanged upon a tree;
translations.web: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

translations.kjv: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
translations.ylt: this one God, a Prince and a Saviour, hath exalted with His right hand, to give reformation to Israel, and forgiveness of sins;
translations.web: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

translations.kjv: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
translations.ylt: and we are His witnesses of these sayings, and the Holy Spirit also, whom God gave to those obeying him.'
translations.web: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

translations.kjv: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
translations.ylt: And they having heard, were cut to the heart, and were taking counsel to slay them,
translations.web: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

translations.kjv: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
translations.ylt: but a certain one, having risen up in the sanhedrim--a Pharisee, by name Gamaliel, a teacher of law honoured by all the people--commanded to put the apostles forth a little,
translations.web: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

translations.kjv: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
translations.ylt: and said unto them, `Men, Israelites, take heed to yourselves about these men, what ye are about to do,
translations.web: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

translations.kjv: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
translations.ylt: for before these days rose up Theudas, saying, that himself was some one, to whom a number of men did join themselves, as it were four hundred, who was slain, and all, as many as were obeying him, were scattered, and came to nought.
translations.web: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

translations.kjv: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
translations.ylt: `After this one rose up, Judas the Galilean, in the days of the enrolment, and drew away much people after him, and that one perished, and all, as many as were obeying him, were scattered;
translations.web: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

translations.kjv: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
translations.ylt: and now I say to you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone, because if this counsel or this work may be of men, it will be overthrown,
translations.web: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

translations.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
translations.ylt: and if it be of God, ye are not able to overthrow it, lest perhaps also ye be found fighting against God.'
translations.web: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

translations.kjv: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
translations.ylt: And to him they agreed, and having called near the apostles, having beaten them, they commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go;
translations.web: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

translations.kjv: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
translations.ylt: they, indeed, then, departed from the presence of the sanhedrim, rejoicing that for his name they were counted worthy to suffer dishonour,
translations.web: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

translations.kjv: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: every day also in the temple, and in every house, they were not ceasing teaching and proclaiming good news--Jesus the Christ.
translations.web: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

translations.kjv: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
translations.ylt: And in these days, the disciples multiplying, there came a murmuring of the Hellenists at the Hebrews, because their widows were being overlooked in the daily ministration,
translations.web: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

translations.kjv: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
translations.ylt: and the twelve, having called near the multitude of the disciples, said, `It is not pleasing that we, having left the word of God, do minister at tables;
translations.web: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
translations.ylt: look out, therefore, brethren, seven men of you who are well testified of, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may set over this necessity,
translations.web: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

translations.kjv: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
translations.ylt: and we to prayer, and to the ministration of the word, will give ourselves continually.'
translations.web: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

translations.kjv: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
translations.ylt: And the thing was pleasing before all the multitude, and they did choose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,
translations.web: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

translations.kjv: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
translations.ylt: whom they did set before the apostles, and they, having prayed, laid on them their hands.
translations.web: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

translations.kjv: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
