translations.ylt: And the word of God did increase, and the number of the disciples did multiply in Jerusalem exceedingly; a great multitude also of the priests were obedient to the faith.
translations.web: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

translations.kjv: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
translations.ylt: And Stephen, full of faith and power, was doing great wonders and signs among the people,
translations.web: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

translations.kjv: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
translations.ylt: and there arose certain of those of the synagogue, called of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of those from Cilicia, and Asia, disputing with Stephen,
translations.web: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

translations.kjv: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
translations.ylt: and they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit with which he was speaking;
translations.web: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

translations.kjv: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
translations.ylt: then they suborned men, saying--`We have heard him speaking evil sayings in regard to Moses and God.'
translations.web: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

translations.kjv: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
translations.ylt: They did stir up also the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and having come upon him, they caught him, and brought him to the sanhedrim;
translations.web: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

translations.kjv: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
translations.ylt: they set up also false witnesses, saying, `This one doth not cease to speak evil sayings against this holy place and the law,
translations.web: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

translations.kjv: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
translations.ylt: for we have heard him saying, That this Jesus the Nazarean shall overthrow this place, and shall change the customs that Moses delivered to us;'
translations.web: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

translations.kjv: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
translations.ylt: and gazing at him, all those sitting in the sanhedrim saw his face as it were the face of a messenger.
translations.web: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

translations.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
translations.ylt: And the chief priest said, `Are then these things so?'
translations.web: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

translations.kjv: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
translations.ylt: and he said, `Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken: The God of the glory did appear to our father Abraham, being in Mesopotamia, before his dwelling in Haran,
translations.web: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

translations.kjv: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
translations.ylt: and He said to him, Go forth out of thy land, and out of thy kindred, and come to a land that I shall shew thee.
translations.web: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

translations.kjv: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
translations.ylt: `Then having come forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, he dwelt in Haran, and from thence, after the death of his father, He did remove him to this land wherein ye now dwell,
translations.web: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

translations.kjv: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
translations.ylt: and He gave him no inheritance in it, not even a footstep, and did promise to give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him--he having no child.
translations.web: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

translations.kjv: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
translations.ylt: `And God spake thus, That his seed shall be sojourning in a strange land, and they shall cause it to serve, and shall do it evil four hundred years,
translations.web: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

translations.kjv: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
translations.ylt: and the nation whom they shall serve I will judge, said God; and after these things they shall come forth and shall do Me service in this place.
translations.web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

translations.kjv: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
translations.ylt: `And He gave to him a covenant of circumcision, and so he begat Isaac, and did circumcise him on the eighth day, and Isaac begat Jacob, and Jacob--the twelve patriarchs;
translations.web: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

translations.kjv: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
translations.ylt: and the patriarchs, having been moved with jealousy, sold Joseph to Egypt, and God was with him,
translations.web: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

translations.kjv: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
translations.ylt: and did deliver him out of all his tribulations, and gave him favour and wisdom before Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he did set him--governor over Egypt and all his house.
translations.web: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

translations.kjv: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
translations.ylt: `And there came a dearth upon all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great tribulation, and our fathers were not finding sustenance,
translations.web: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

translations.kjv: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
translations.ylt: and Jacob having heard that there was corn in Egypt, sent forth our fathers a first time;
translations.web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

translations.kjv: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
translations.ylt: and at the second time was Joseph made known to his brethren, and Joseph's kindred became manifest to Pharaoh,
translations.web: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

translations.kjv: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
translations.ylt: and Joseph having sent, did call for his father Jacob, and all his kindred--with seventy and five souls--
translations.web: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

translations.kjv: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
translations.ylt: and Jacob went down to Egypt, and died, himself and our fathers,
translations.web: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

translations.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
translations.ylt: and they were carried over into Sychem, and were laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in money from the sons of Emmor, of Sychem.
translations.web: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

translations.kjv: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
translations.ylt: `And according as the time of the promise was drawing nigh, which God did swear to Abraham, the people increased and multiplied in Egypt,
translations.web: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

translations.kjv: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
translations.ylt: till another king rose, who had not known Joseph;
translations.web: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

translations.kjv: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
translations.ylt: this one, having dealt subtilely with our kindred, did evil to our fathers, causing to expose their babes, that they might not live;
translations.web: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

translations.kjv: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
translations.ylt: in which time Moses was born, and he was fair to God, and he was brought up three months in the house of his father;
translations.web: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

translations.kjv: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
translations.ylt: and he having been exposed, the daughter of Pharaoh took him up, and did rear him to herself for a son;
translations.web: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

translations.kjv: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
translations.ylt: and Moses was taught in all wisdom of the Egyptians, and he was powerful in words and in works.
translations.web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

translations.kjv: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
translations.ylt: `And when forty years were fulfilled to him, it came upon his heart to look after his brethren, the sons of Israel;
translations.web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

translations.kjv: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
translations.ylt: and having seen a certain one suffering injustice, he did defend, and did justice to the oppressed, having smitten the Egyptian;
translations.web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

translations.kjv: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
translations.ylt: and he was supposing his brethren to understand that God through his hand doth give salvation; and they did not understand.
translations.web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

translations.kjv: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
translations.ylt: `On the succeeding day, also, he shewed himself to them as they are striving, and urged them to peace, saying, Men, brethren are ye, wherefore do ye injustice to one another?
translations.web: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

translations.kjv: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
translations.ylt: and he who is doing injustice to the neighbour, did thrust him away, saying, Who set thee a ruler and a judge over us?
translations.web: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

translations.kjv: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
translations.ylt: to kill me dost thou wish, as thou didst kill yesterday the Egyptian?
translations.web: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

translations.kjv: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
translations.ylt: `And Moses fled at this word, and became a sojourner in the land of Midian, where he begat two sons,
translations.web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

translations.kjv: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
translations.ylt: and forty years having been fulfilled, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai a messenger of the Lord, in a flame of fire of a bush,
translations.web: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

translations.kjv: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
translations.ylt: and Moses having seen did wonder at the sight; and he drawing near to behold, there came a voice of the Lord unto him,
translations.web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

translations.kjv: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
translations.ylt: I am the God of thy fathers; the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. `And Moses having become terrified, durst not behold,
translations.web: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

translations.kjv: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
translations.ylt: and the Lord said to him, Loose the sandal of thy feet, for the place in which thou hast stood is holy ground;
translations.web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

translations.kjv: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
translations.ylt: seeing I have seen the affliction of My people that is in Egypt, and their groaning I did hear, and came down to deliver them; and now come, I will send thee to Egypt.
translations.web: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

translations.kjv: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
translations.ylt: `This Moses, whom they did refuse, saying, Who did set thee a ruler and a judge? this one God a ruler and a redeemer did send, in the hand of a messenger who appeared to him in the bush;
translations.web: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

translations.kjv: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
translations.ylt: this one did bring them forth, having done wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness forty years;
translations.web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

translations.kjv: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
translations.ylt: this is the Moses who did say to the sons of Israel: A prophet to you shall the Lord your God raise up out of your brethren, like to me, him shall ye hear.
translations.web: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

translations.kjv: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
translations.ylt: `This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness, with the messenger who is speaking to him in the mount Sinai, and with our fathers who did receive the living oracles to give to us;
translations.web: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

translations.kjv: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
translations.ylt: to whom our fathers did not wish to become obedient, but did thrust away, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
translations.web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

translations.kjv: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
translations.ylt: saying to Aaron, Make to us gods who shall go on before us, for this Moses, who brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, we have not known what hath happened to him.
translations.web: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

translations.kjv: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
translations.ylt: `And they made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and were rejoicing in the works of their hands,
translations.web: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

translations.kjv: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
translations.ylt: and God did turn, and did give them up to do service to the host of the heaven, according as it hath been written in the scroll of the prophets: Slain beasts and sacrifices did ye offer to Me forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
translations.web: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

translations.kjv: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
translations.ylt: and ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan--the figures that ye made to bow before them, and I will remove your dwelling beyond Babylon.
translations.web: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

translations.kjv: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
translations.ylt: `The tabernacle of the testimony was among our fathers in the wilderness, according as He did direct, who is speaking to Moses, to make it according to the figure that he had seen;
translations.web: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

translations.kjv: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
translations.ylt: which also our fathers having in succession received, did bring in with Joshua, into the possession of the nations whom God did drive out from the presence of our fathers, till the days of David,
translations.web: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

translations.kjv: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
translations.ylt: who found favour before God, and requested to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob;
translations.web: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

translations.kjv: But Solomon built him an house.
translations.ylt: and Solomon built Him an house.
translations.web: But Solomon built him a house.

translations.kjv: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
translations.ylt: `But the Most High in sanctuaries made with hands doth not dwell, according as the prophet saith:
translations.web: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

translations.kjv: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
translations.ylt: The heaven is My throne, and the earth My footstool; what house will ye build to Me? saith the Lord, or what is the place of My rest?
translations.web: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

translations.kjv: Hath not my hand made all these things?
translations.ylt: hath not My hand made all these things?
translations.web: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

translations.kjv: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
translations.ylt: `Ye stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and in ears! ye do always the Holy Spirit resist; as your fathers--also ye;
translations.web: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

translations.kjv: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
translations.ylt: which of the prophets did not your fathers persecute? and they killed those who declared before about the coming of the Righteous One, of whom now ye betrayers and murderers have become,
translations.web: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

translations.kjv: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
translations.ylt: who received the law by arrangement of messengers, and did not keep it.'
translations.web: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

translations.kjv: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
translations.ylt: And hearing these things, they were cut to the hearts, and did gnash the teeth at him;
translations.web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

translations.kjv: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
translations.ylt: and being full of the Holy Spirit, having looked stedfastly to the heaven, he saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
translations.web: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

translations.kjv: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Lo, I see the heavens having been opened, and the Son of Man standing on the right hand of God.'
translations.web: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

translations.kjv: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
translations.ylt: And they, having cried out with a loud voice, stopped their ears, and did rush with one accord upon him,
translations.web: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

translations.kjv: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
translations.ylt: and having cast him forth outside of the city, they were stoning him --and the witnesses did put down their garments at the feet of a young man called Saul--
translations.web: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

translations.kjv: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
translations.ylt: and they were stoning Stephen, calling and saying, `Lord Jesus, receive my spirit;'
translations.web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

translations.kjv: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
translations.ylt: and having bowed the knees, he cried with a loud voice, `Lord, mayest thou not lay to them this sin;' and this having said, he fell asleep.
translations.web: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

translations.kjv: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
translations.ylt: And Saul was assenting to his death, and there came in that day a great persecution upon the assembly in Jerusalem, all also were scattered abroad in the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles;
translations.web: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

translations.kjv: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
translations.ylt: and devout men carried away Stephen, and made great lamentation over him;
translations.web: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

translations.kjv: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
translations.ylt: and Saul was making havoc of the assembly, into every house entering, and haling men and women, was giving them up to prison;
translations.web: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

translations.kjv: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
translations.ylt: they then indeed, having been scattered, went abroad proclaiming good news--the word.
translations.web: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

translations.kjv: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
translations.ylt: And Philip having gone down to a city of Samaria, was preaching to them the Christ,
translations.web: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

translations.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
translations.ylt: the multitudes also were giving heed to the things spoken by Philip, with one accord, in their hearing and seeing the signs that he was doing,
translations.web: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

translations.kjv: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
translations.ylt: for unclean spirits came forth from many who were possessed, crying with a loud voice, and many who have been paralytic and lame were healed,
translations.web: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

translations.kjv: And there was great joy in that city.
translations.ylt: and there was great joy in that city.
translations.web: There was great joy in that city.

translations.kjv: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
translations.ylt: And a certain man, by name Simon, was before in the city using magic, and amazing the nation of Samaria, saying himself to be a certain great one,
translations.web: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

translations.kjv: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
translations.ylt: to whom they were all giving heed, from small unto great, saying, `This one is the great power of God;'
translations.web: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

translations.kjv: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
translations.ylt: and they were giving heed to him, because of his having for a long time amazed them with deeds of magic.
translations.web: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

translations.kjv: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
translations.ylt: And when they believed Philip, proclaiming good news, the things concerning the reign of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized both men and women;
translations.web: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

translations.kjv: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
translations.ylt: and Simon also himself did believe, and, having been baptized, he was continuing with Philip, beholding also signs and mighty acts being done, he was amazed.
translations.web: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

translations.kjv: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
translations.ylt: And the apostles in Jerusalem having heard that Samaria hath received the word of God, did send unto them Peter and John,
translations.web: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

translations.kjv: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
translations.ylt: who having come down did pray concerning them, that they may receive the Holy Spirit, --
translations.web: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

translations.kjv: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
translations.ylt: for as yet he was fallen upon none of them, and only they have been baptized--to the name of the Lord Jesus;
translations.web: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

translations.kjv: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: then were they laying hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
translations.ylt: And Simon, having beheld that through the laying on of the hands of the apostles, the Holy Spirit is given, brought before them money,
translations.web: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

translations.kjv: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: saying, `Give also to me this authority, that on whomsoever I may lay the hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit.'
translations.web: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

translations.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
translations.ylt: And Peter said unto him, `Thy silver with thee--may it be to destruction! because the gift of God thou didst think to possess through money;
translations.web: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

translations.kjv: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
translations.ylt: thou hast neither part nor lot in this thing, for thy heart is not right before God;
translations.web: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

translations.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
translations.ylt: reform, therefore, from this thy wickedness, and beseech God, if then the purpose of thy heart may be forgiven thee,
translations.web: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

translations.kjv: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
translations.ylt: for in the gall of bitterness, and bond of unrighteousness, I perceive thee being.'
translations.web: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

translations.kjv: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
translations.ylt: And Simon answering, said, `Beseech ye for me unto the Lord, that nothing may come upon me of the things ye have spoken.'
translations.web: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

translations.kjv: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
translations.ylt: They indeed, therefore, having testified fully, and spoken the word of the Lord, did turn back to Jerusalem; in many villages also of the Samaritans they did proclaim good news.
translations.web: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

translations.kjv: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
translations.ylt: And a messenger of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, `Arise, and go on toward the south, on the way that is going down from Jerusalem to Gaza,' --this is desert.
translations.web: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

translations.kjv: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
translations.ylt: And having arisen, he went on, and lo, a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch, a man of rank, of Candace the queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to worship to Jerusalem;
translations.web: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

translations.kjv: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
translations.ylt: he was also returning, and is sitting on his chariot, and he was reading the prophet Isaiah.
translations.web: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

translations.kjv: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
translations.ylt: And the Spirit said to Philip, `Go near, and be joined to this chariot;'
translations.web: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

translations.kjv: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
translations.ylt: and Philip having run near, heard him reading the prophet Isaiah, and said, `Dost thou then know what thou dost read?'
translations.web: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

translations.kjv: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
translations.ylt: and he said, `Why, how am I able, if some one may not guide me?' he called Philip also, having come up, to sit with him.
translations.web: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

translations.kjv: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
translations.ylt: And the contents of the Writing that he was reading was this: `As a sheep unto slaughter he was led, and as a lamb before his shearer dumb, so he doth not open his mouth;
translations.web: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

translations.kjv: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
translations.ylt: in his humiliation his judgment was taken away, and his generation--who shall declare? because taken from the earth is his life.'
translations.web: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

translations.kjv: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
translations.ylt: And the eunuch answering Philip said, `I pray thee, about whom doth the prophet say this? about himself, or about some other one?'
translations.web: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

translations.kjv: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
translations.ylt: and Philip having opened his mouth, and having begun from this Writing, proclaimed good news to him--Jesus.
translations.web: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

translations.kjv: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
translations.ylt: And as they were going on the way, they came upon a certain water, and the eunuch said, `Lo, water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?'
translations.web: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

translations.kjv: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
translations.ylt: and he commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down to the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him;
translations.web: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

translations.kjv: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
translations.ylt: and when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, and the eunuch saw him no more, for he was going on his way rejoicing;
translations.web: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

translations.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Cesarea.
translations.ylt: and Philip was found at Azotus, and passing through, he was proclaiming good news to all the cities, till his coming to Caesarea.
translations.web: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

translations.kjv: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
translations.ylt: And Saul, yet breathing of threatening and slaughter to the disciples of the Lord, having gone to the chief priest,
translations.web: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

translations.kjv: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: did ask from him letters to Damascus, unto the synagogues, that if he may find any being of the way, both men and women, he may bring them bound to Jerusalem.
translations.web: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
translations.ylt: And in the going, he came nigh to Damascus, and suddenly there shone round about him a light from the heaven,
translations.web: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

translations.kjv: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
translations.ylt: and having fallen upon the earth, he heard a voice saying to him, `Saul, Saul, why me dost thou persecute?'
translations.web: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

translations.kjv: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
translations.ylt: And he said, `Who art thou, Lord?' and the Lord said, `I am Jesus whom thou dost persecute; hard for thee at the pricks to kick;'
translations.web: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

translations.kjv: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
translations.ylt: trembling also, and astonished, he said, `Lord, what dost thou wish me to do?' and the Lord said unto him, `Arise, and enter into the city, and it shall be told thee what it behoveth thee to do.'
translations.web: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

translations.kjv: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
translations.ylt: And the men who are journeying with him stood speechless, hearing indeed the voice but seeing no one,
translations.web: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

translations.kjv: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
translations.ylt: and Saul arose from the earth, and his eyes having been opened, he beheld no one, and leading him by the hand they brought him to Damascus,
translations.web: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

translations.kjv: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
translations.ylt: and he was three days without seeing, and he did neither eat nor drink.
translations.web: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

translations.kjv: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
translations.ylt: And there was a certain disciple in Damascus, by name Ananias, and the Lord said unto him in a vision, `Ananias;' and he said, `Behold me, Lord;'
translations.web: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

translations.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
translations.ylt: and the Lord saith unto him, `Having risen, go on unto the street that is called Straight, and seek in the house of Judas, one by name Saul of Tarsus, for, lo, he doth pray,
translations.web: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

translations.kjv: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
translations.ylt: and he saw in a vision a man, by name Ananias, coming in, and putting a hand on him, that he may see again.'
translations.web: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

translations.kjv: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
translations.ylt: And Ananias answered, `Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how many evils he did to Thy saints in Jerusalem,
translations.web: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
translations.ylt: and here he hath authority from the chief priests, to bind all those calling on Thy name.'
translations.web: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

translations.kjv: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
translations.ylt: And the Lord said unto him, `Be going on, because a choice vessel to Me is this one, to bear My name before nations and kings--the sons also of Israel;
translations.web: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

translations.kjv: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name’s sake.
translations.ylt: for I will shew him how many things it behoveth him for My name to suffer.'
translations.web: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

translations.kjv: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: And Ananias went away, and did enter into the house, and having put upon him his hands, said, `Saul, brother, the Lord hath sent me--Jesus who did appear to thee in the way in which thou wast coming--that thou mayest see again, and mayest be filled with the Holy Spirit.'
translations.web: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

translations.kjv: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
translations.ylt: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it were scales, he saw again also presently, and having risen, was baptized,
translations.web: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

translations.kjv: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
translations.ylt: and having received nourishment, was strengthened, and Saul was with the disciples in Damascus certain days,
translations.web: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

translations.kjv: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
translations.ylt: and immediately in the synagogues he was preaching the Christ, that he is the Son of God.
translations.web: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

translations.kjv: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
translations.ylt: And all those hearing were amazed, and said, `Is not this he who laid waist in Jerusalem those calling on this name, and hither to this intent had come, that he might bring them bound to the chief priests?'
translations.web: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

translations.kjv: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
translations.ylt: And Saul was still more strengthened, and he was confounding the Jews dwelling in Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.
translations.web: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

translations.kjv: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
translations.ylt: And when many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel together to kill him,
translations.web: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

translations.kjv: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
translations.ylt: and their counsel against him was known to Saul; they were also watching the gates both day and night, that they may kill him,
translations.web: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

translations.kjv: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
translations.ylt: and the disciples having taken him, by night did let him down by the wall, letting down in a basket.
translations.web: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

translations.kjv: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
translations.ylt: And Saul, having come to Jerusalem, did try to join himself to the disciples, and they were all afraid of him, not believing that he is a disciple,
translations.web: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

translations.kjv: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
translations.ylt: and Barnabas having taken him, brought him unto the apostles, and did declare to them how in the way he saw the Lord, and that he spake to him, and how in Damascus he was speaking boldly in the name of Jesus.
translations.web: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

translations.kjv: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: And he was with them, coming in and going out in Jerusalem,
translations.web: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

translations.kjv: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
translations.ylt: and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, he was both speaking and disputing with the Hellenists, and they were taking in hand to kill him,
translations.web: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

translations.kjv: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
translations.ylt: and the brethren having known, brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
translations.web: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

translations.kjv: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
translations.ylt: Then, indeed, the assemblies throughout all Judea, and Galilee, and Samaria, had peace, being built up, and, going on in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, they were multiplied.
translations.web: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass that Peter passing throughout all quarters, came down also unto the saints who were dwelling at Lydda,
translations.web: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

translations.kjv: And there he found a certain man named Eneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
translations.ylt: and he found there a certain man, Aeneas by name--for eight years laid upon a couch--who was paralytic,
translations.web: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

translations.kjv: And Peter said unto him, Eneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
translations.ylt: and Peter said to him, `Aeneas, heal thee doth Jesus the Christ; arise and spread for thyself;' and immediately he rose,
translations.web: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

translations.kjv: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
translations.ylt: and all those dwelling at Lydda, and Saron saw him, and did turn to the Lord.
translations.web: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

translations.kjv: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
translations.ylt: And in Joppa there was a certain female disciple, by name Tabitha, (which interpreted, is called Dorcas,) this woman was full of good works and kind acts that she was doing;
translations.web: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
translations.ylt: and it came to pass in those days she, having ailed, died, and having bathed her, they laid her in an upper chamber,
translations.web: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

translations.kjv: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
translations.ylt: and Lydda being nigh to Joppa, the disciples having heard that Peter is in that place, sent two men unto him, calling on him not to delay to come through unto them.
translations.web: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

translations.kjv: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
translations.ylt: And Peter having risen, went with them, whom having come, they brought into the upper chamber, and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing coats and garments, as many as Dorcas was making while she was with them.
translations.web: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

translations.kjv: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translations.ylt: And Peter having put them all forth without, having bowed the knees, did pray, and having turned unto the body said, `Tabitha, arise;' and she opened her eyes, and having seen Peter, she sat up,
translations.web: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

translations.kjv: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
translations.ylt: and having given her his hand, he lifted her up, and having called the saints and the widows, he presented her alive,
translations.web: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

translations.kjv: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
translations.ylt: and it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed on the Lord;
translations.web: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
translations.ylt: and it came to pass, that he remained many days in Joppa, with a certain one, Simon a tanner.
translations.web: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

translations.kjv: There was a certain man in Cesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
translations.ylt: And there was a certain man in Caesarea, by name Cornelius, a centurion from a band called Italian,
translations.web: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

translations.kjv: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
translations.ylt: pious, and fearing God with all his house, doing also many kind acts to the people, and beseeching God always,
translations.web: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

translations.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
translations.ylt: he saw in a vision manifestly, as it were the ninth hour of the day, a messenger of God coming in unto him, and saying to him, `Cornelius;'
translations.web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

translations.kjv: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
translations.ylt: and he having looked earnestly on him, and becoming afraid, said, `What is it, Lord?' And he said to him, `Thy prayers and thy kind acts came up for a memorial before God,
translations.web: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

translations.kjv: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
translations.ylt: and now send men to Joppa, and send for a certain one Simon, who is surnamed Peter,
translations.web: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

translations.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
translations.ylt: this one doth lodge with a certain Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea; this one shall speak to thee what it behoveth thee to do.'
translations.web: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

translations.kjv: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
translations.ylt: And when the messenger who is speaking to Cornelius went away, having called two of his domestics, and a pious soldier of those waiting on him continually,
translations.web: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

translations.kjv: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
translations.ylt: and having declared to them all things, he sent them to Joppa.
translations.web: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

translations.kjv: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
translations.ylt: And on the morrow, as these are proceeding on the way, and are drawing nigh to the city, Peter went up upon the house-top to pray, about the sixth hour,
translations.web: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

translations.kjv: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
translations.ylt: and he became very hungry, and wished to eat; and they making ready, there fell upon him a trance,
translations.web: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

translations.kjv: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
translations.ylt: and he doth behold the heaven opened, and descending unto him a certain vessel, as a great sheet, bound at the four corners, and let down upon the earth,
translations.web: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

translations.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
translations.ylt: in which were all the four-footed beasts of the earth, and the wild beasts, and the creeping things, and the fowls of the heaven,
translations.web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

translations.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
translations.ylt: and there came a voice unto him: `Having risen, Peter, slay and eat.'
translations.web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

translations.kjv: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
translations.ylt: And Peter said, `Not so, Lord; because at no time did I eat anything common or unclean;'
translations.web: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

translations.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
translations.ylt: and there is a voice again a second time unto him: `What God did cleanse, thou, declare not thou common;'
translations.web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

translations.kjv: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
translations.ylt: and this was done thrice, and again was the vessel received up to the heaven.
translations.web: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

translations.kjv: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon’s house, and stood before the gate,
translations.ylt: And as Peter was perplexed in himself what the vision that he saw might be, then, lo, the men who have been sent from Cornelius, having made inquiry for the house of Simon, stood at the gate,
translations.web: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

translations.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
translations.ylt: and having called, they were asking if Simon, who is surnamed Peter, doth lodge here?
translations.web: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

translations.kjv: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
translations.ylt: And Peter thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, `Lo, three men do seek thee;
translations.web: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

translations.kjv: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
translations.ylt: but having risen, go down and go on with them, nothing doubting, because I have sent them;'
translations.web: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
translations.ylt: and Peter having come down unto the men who have been sent from Cornelius unto him, said, `Lo, I am he whom ye seek, what is the cause for which ye are present?'
translations.web: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

translations.kjv: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
translations.ylt: And they said, `Cornelius, a centurion, a man righteous and fearing God, well testified to, also, by all the nation of the Jews, was divinely warned by a holy messenger to send for thee, to his house, and to hear sayings from thee.'
translations.web: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

translations.kjv: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
translations.ylt: Having called them in, therefore, he lodged them, and on the morrow Peter went forth with them, and certain of the brethren from Joppa went with him,
translations.web: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

translations.kjv: And the morrow after they entered into Cesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
translations.ylt: and on the morrow they did enter into Caesarea; and Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his kindred and near friends,
translations.web: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

translations.kjv: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
translations.ylt: and as it came that Peter entered in, Cornelius having met him, having fallen at his feet, did bow before him;
translations.web: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

translations.kjv: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
translations.ylt: and Peter raised him, saying, `Stand up; I also myself am a man;'
translations.web: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

translations.kjv: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
translations.ylt: and talking with him he went in, and doth find many having come together.
translations.web: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
translations.ylt: And he said unto them, `Ye know how it is unlawful for a man, a Jew, to keep company with, or to come unto, one of another race, but to me God did shew to call no man common or unclean;
translations.web: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

translations.kjv: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
translations.ylt: therefore also without gainsaying I came, having been sent for; I ask, therefore, for what matter ye did send for me?'
translations.web: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

translations.kjv: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
translations.ylt: And Cornelius said, `Four days ago till this hour, I was fasting, and at the ninth hour praying in my house, and, lo, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
translations.web: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

translations.kjv: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
translations.ylt: and he said, Cornelius, thy prayer was heard, and thy kind acts were remembered before God;
translations.web: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

translations.kjv: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
translations.ylt: send, therefore, to Joppa, and call for Simon, who is surnamed Peter; this one doth lodge in the house of Simon a tanner, by the sea, who having come, shall speak to thee;
translations.web: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

translations.kjv: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
translations.ylt: at once, therefore, I sent to thee; thou also didst do well, having come; now, therefore, are we all before God present to hear all things that have been commanded thee by God.'
translations.web: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

translations.kjv: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
translations.ylt: And Peter having opened his mouth, said, `Of a truth, I perceive that God is no respecter of persons,
translations.web: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

translations.kjv: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
translations.ylt: but in every nation he who is fearing Him, and is working righteousness, is acceptable to Him;
translations.web: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

translations.kjv: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
translations.ylt: the word that he sent to the sons of Israel, proclaiming good news--peace through Jesus Christ (this one is Lord of all,)
translations.web: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

translations.kjv: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
translations.ylt: ye--ye have known; --the word that came throughout all Judea, having begun from Galilee, after the baptism that John preached;
translations.web: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

translations.kjv: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
translations.ylt: Jesus who is from Nazareth--how God did anoint him with the Holy Spirit and power; who went through, doing good, and healing all those oppressed by the devil, because God was with him;
translations.web: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.
