translations.kjv: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
translations.ylt: and we--we are witnesses of all things that he did, both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem, --whom they did slay, having hanged upon a tree.
translations.web: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

translations.kjv: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
translations.ylt: `This one God did raise up the third day, and gave him to become manifest,
translations.web: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

translations.kjv: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
translations.ylt: not to all the people, but to witnesses, to those having been chosen before by God--to us who did eat with him, and did drink with him, after his rising out of the dead;
translations.web: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

translations.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
translations.ylt: and he commanded us to preach to the people, and to testify fully that it is he who hath been ordained by God judge of living and dead--
translations.web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

translations.kjv: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
translations.ylt: to this one do all the prophets testify, that through his name every one that is believing in him doth receive remission of sins.'
translations.web: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

translations.kjv: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
translations.ylt: While Peter is yet speaking these sayings, the Holy spirit fell upon all those hearing the word,
translations.web: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

translations.kjv: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and those of the circumcision believing were astonished--as many as came with Peter--because also upon the nations the gift of the Holy Spirit hath been poured out,
translations.web: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

translations.kjv: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
translations.ylt: for they were hearing them speaking with tongues and magnifying God.
translations.web: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

translations.kjv: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
translations.ylt: Then answered Peter, `The water is any one able to forbid, that these may not be baptized, who the Holy Spirit did receive--even as also we?'
translations.web: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

translations.kjv: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
translations.ylt: he commanded them also to be baptized in the name of the Lord; then they besought him to remain certain days.
translations.web: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

translations.kjv: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
translations.ylt: And the apostles and the brethren who are in Judea heard that also the nations did receive the word of God,
translations.web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

translations.kjv: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
translations.ylt: and when Peter came up to Jerusalem, those of the circumcision were contending with him,
translations.web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

translations.kjv: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
translations.ylt: saying--`Unto men uncircumcised thou didst go in, and didst eat with them!'
translations.web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

translations.kjv: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
translations.ylt: And Peter having begun, did expound to them in order saying,
translations.web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

translations.kjv: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
translations.ylt: `I was in the city of Joppa praying, and I saw in a trance a vision, a certain vessel coming down, as a great sheet by four corners being let down out of the heaven, and it came unto me;
translations.web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

translations.kjv: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
translations.ylt: at which having looked stedfastly, I was considering, and I saw the four-footed beasts of the earth, and the wild beasts, and the creeping things, and the fowls of heaven;
translations.web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

translations.kjv: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
translations.ylt: and I heard a voice saying to me, Having risen, Peter, slay and eat;
translations.web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

translations.kjv: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
translations.ylt: and I said, Not so, Lord; because anything common or unclean hath at no time entered into my mouth;
translations.web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

translations.kjv: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
translations.ylt: and a voice did answer me a second time out of the heaven, What God did cleanse, thou--declare not thou common.
translations.web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

translations.kjv: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
translations.ylt: `And this happened thrice, and again was all drawn up to the heaven,
translations.web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

translations.kjv: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cesarea unto me.
translations.ylt: and, lo, immediately, three men stood at the house in which I was, having been sent from Caesarea unto me,
translations.web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

translations.kjv: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
translations.ylt: and the Spirit said to me to go with them, nothing doubting, and these six brethren also went with me, and we did enter into the house of the man,
translations.web: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

translations.kjv: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
translations.ylt: he declared also to us how he saw the messenger in his house standing, and saying to him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, who is surnamed Peter,
translations.web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

translations.kjv: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
translations.ylt: who shall speak sayings by which thou shalt be saved, thou and all thy house.
translations.web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

translations.kjv: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
translations.ylt: `And in my beginning to speak, the Holy Spirit did fall upon them, even as also upon us in the beginning,
translations.web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

translations.kjv: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and I remembered the saying of the Lord, how he said, John indeed did baptize with water, and ye shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit;
translations.web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

translations.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
translations.ylt: if then the equal gift God did give to them as also to us, having believed upon the Lord Jesus Christ, I--how was I able to withstand God?'
translations.web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

translations.kjv: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
translations.ylt: And they, having heard these things, were silent, and were glorifying God, saying, `Then, indeed, also to the nations did God give the reformation to life.'
translations.web: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

translations.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
translations.ylt: Those, indeed, therefore, having been scattered abroad, from the tribulation that came after Stephen, went through unto Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to none except to Jews only;
translations.web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

translations.kjv: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
translations.ylt: and there were certain of them men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who having entered into Antioch, were speaking unto the Hellenists, proclaiming good news--the Lord Jesus,
translations.web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

translations.kjv: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
translations.ylt: and the hand of the Lord was with them, a great number also, having believed, did turn unto the Lord.
translations.web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

translations.kjv: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
translations.ylt: And the account was heard in the ears of the assembly that is in Jerusalem concerning them, and they sent forth Barnabas to go through unto Antioch,
translations.web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

translations.kjv: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
translations.ylt: who, having come, and having seen the grace of God, was glad, and was exhorting all with purpose of heart to cleave to the Lord,
translations.web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

translations.kjv: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
translations.ylt: because he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit, and of faith, and a great multitude was added to the Lord.
translations.web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

translations.kjv: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
translations.ylt: And Barnabas went forth to Tarsus, to seek for Saul,
translations.web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

translations.kjv: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
translations.ylt: and having found him, he brought him to Antioch, and it came to pass that they a whole year did assemble together in the assembly, and taught a great multitude, the disciples also were divinely called first in Antioch Christians.
translations.web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

translations.kjv: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
translations.ylt: And in those days there came from Jerusalem prophets to Antioch,
translations.web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

translations.kjv: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cesar.
translations.ylt: and one of them, by name Agabus, having stood up, did signify through the Spirit a great dearth is about to be throughout all the world--which also came to pass in the time of Claudius Caesar--
translations.web: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

translations.kjv: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judea:
translations.ylt: and the disciples, according as any one was prospering, determined each of them to send for ministration to the brethren dwelling in Judea,
translations.web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

translations.kjv: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
translations.ylt: which also they did, having sent unto the elders by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
translations.web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

translations.kjv: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
translations.ylt: And about that time, Herod the king put forth his hands, to do evil to certain of those of the assembly,
translations.web: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

translations.kjv: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
translations.ylt: and he killed James, the brother of John, with the sword,
translations.web: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

translations.kjv: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
translations.ylt: and having seen that it is pleasing to the Jews, he added to lay hold of Peter also--and they were the days of the unleavened food--
translations.web: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

translations.kjv: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
translations.ylt: whom also having seized, he did put in prison, having delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to guard him, intending after the passover to bring him forth to the people.
translations.web: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

translations.kjv: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
translations.ylt: Peter, therefore, indeed, was kept in the prison, and fervent prayer was being made by the assembly unto God for him,
translations.web: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

translations.kjv: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
translations.ylt: and when Herod was about to bring him forth, the same night was Peter sleeping between two soldiers, having been bound with two chains, guards also before the door were keeping the prison,
translations.web: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

translations.kjv: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
translations.ylt: and lo, a messenger of the Lord stood by, and a light shone in the buildings, and having smitten Peter on the side, he raised him up, saying, `Rise in haste,' and his chains fell from off his hands.
translations.web: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

translations.kjv: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
translations.ylt: The messenger also said to him, `Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals;' and he did so; and he saith to him, `Put thy garment round and be following me;'
translations.web: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

translations.kjv: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
translations.ylt: and having gone forth, he was following him, and he knew not that it is true that which is done through the messenger, and was thinking he saw a vision,
translations.web: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

translations.kjv: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
translations.ylt: and having passed through a first ward, and a second, they came unto the iron gate that is leading to the city, which of its own accord did open to them, and having gone forth, they went on through one street, and immediately the messenger departed from him.
translations.web: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

translations.kjv: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
translations.ylt: And Peter having come to himself, said, `Now I have known of a truth that the Lord did sent forth His messenger, and did deliver me out of the hand of Herod, and all the expectation of the people of the Jews;'
translations.web: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

translations.kjv: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
translations.ylt: also, having considered, he came unto the house of Mary, the mother of John, who is surnamed Mark, where there were many thronged together and praying.
translations.web: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

translations.kjv: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
translations.ylt: And Peter having knocked at the door of the porch, there came a damsel to hearken, by name Rhoda,
translations.web: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

translations.kjv: And when she knew Peter’s voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
translations.ylt: and having known the voice of Peter, from the joy she did not open the porch, but having run in, told of the standing of Peter before the porch,
translations.web: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

translations.kjv: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
translations.ylt: and they said unto her, `Thou art mad;' and she was confidently affirming it to be so, and they said, `It is his messenger;'
translations.web: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

translations.kjv: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
translations.ylt: and Peter was continuing knocking, and having opened, they saw him, and were astonished,
translations.web: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

translations.kjv: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
translations.ylt: and having beckoned to them with the hand to be silent, he declared to them how the Lord brought him out of the prison, and he said, `Declare to James and to the brethren these things;' and having gone forth, he went on to another place.
translations.web: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

translations.kjv: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
translations.ylt: And day having come, there was not a little stir among the soldiers what then was become of Peter,
translations.web: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

translations.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judea to Cesarea, and there abode.
translations.ylt: and Herod having sought for him, and not having found, having examined the guards, did command them to be led away to punishment, and having gone down from Judea to Caesarea, he was abiding there.
translations.web: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

translations.kjv: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
translations.ylt: And Herod was highly displeased with the Tyrians and Sidonians, and with one accord they came unto him, and having made a friend of Blastus, who is over the bed-chambers of the king, they were asking peace, because of their country being nourished from the king's;
translations.web: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

translations.kjv: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
translations.ylt: and on a set day, Herod having arrayed himself in kingly apparel, and having sat down upon the tribunal, was making an oration unto them,
translations.web: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

translations.kjv: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
translations.ylt: and the populace were shouting, `The voice of a god, and not of a man;'
translations.web: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

translations.kjv: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
translations.ylt: and presently there smote him a messenger of the Lord, because he did not give the glory to God, and having been eaten of worms, he expired.
translations.web: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

translations.kjv: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
translations.ylt: And the word of God did grow and did multiply,
translations.web: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

translations.kjv: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
translations.ylt: and Barnabas and Saul did turn back out of Jerusalem, having fulfilled the ministration, having taken also with them John, who was surnamed Mark.
translations.web: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

translations.kjv: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
translations.ylt: And there were certain in Antioch, in the assembly there, prophets and teachers; both Barnabas, and Simeon who is called Niger, and Lucius the Cyrenian, Manaen also--Herod the tetrarch's foster-brother--and Saul;
translations.web: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

translations.kjv: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
translations.ylt: and in their ministering to the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, `Separate ye to me both Barnabas and Saul to the work to which I have called them,'
translations.web: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

translations.kjv: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
translations.ylt: then having fasted, and having prayed, and having laid the hands on them, they sent them away.
translations.web: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

translations.kjv: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
translations.ylt: These, indeed, then, having been sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia, thence also they sailed to Cyprus,
translations.web: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

translations.kjv: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
translations.ylt: and having come unto Salamis, they declared the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews, and they had also John as a ministrant;
translations.web: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

translations.kjv: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar–jesus:
translations.ylt: and having gone through the island unto Paphos, they found a certain magian, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name is Bar-Jesus;
translations.web: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

translations.kjv: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
translations.ylt: who was with the proconsul Sergius Paulus, an intelligent man; this one having called for Barnabas and Saul, did desire to hear the word of God,
translations.web: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

translations.kjv: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
translations.ylt: and there withstood them Elymas the magian--for so is his name interpreted--seeking to pervert the proconsul from the faith.
translations.web: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

translations.kjv: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
translations.ylt: And Saul--who also is Paul--having been filled with the Holy Spirit, and having looked stedfastly on him,
translations.web: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

translations.kjv: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
translations.ylt: said, `O full of all guile, and all profligacy, son of a devil, enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease perverting the right ways of the Lord?
translations.web: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

translations.kjv: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
translations.ylt: and now, lo, a hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season;' and presently there fell upon him a mist and darkness, and he, going about, was seeking some to lead him by the hand;
translations.web: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

translations.kjv: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
translations.ylt: then the proconsul having seen what hath come to pass, did believe, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.
translations.web: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

translations.kjv: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: And those about Paul having set sail from Paphos, came to Perga of Pamphylia, and John having departed from them, did turn back to Jerusalem,
translations.web: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
translations.ylt: and they having gone through from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia, and having gone into the synagogue on the sabbath-day, they sat down,
translations.web: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

translations.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
translations.ylt: and after the reading of the law and of the prophets, the chief men of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, `Men, brethren, if there be a word in you of exhortation unto the people--say on.'
translations.web: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

translations.kjv: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
translations.ylt: And Paul having risen, and having beckoned with the hand, said, `Men, Israelites, and those fearing God, hearken:
translations.web: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

translations.kjv: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
translations.ylt: the God of this people Israel did choose our fathers, and the people He did exalt in their sojourning in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm did He bring them out of it;
translations.web: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

translations.kjv: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
translations.ylt: and about a period of forty years He did suffer their manners in the wilderness,
translations.web: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

translations.kjv: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
translations.ylt: and having destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, He did divide by lot to them their land.
translations.web: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

translations.kjv: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
translations.ylt: `And after these things, about four hundred and fifty years, He gave judges--till Samuel the prophet;
translations.web: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

translations.kjv: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
translations.ylt: and thereafter they asked for a king, and God did give to them Saul, son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years;
translations.web: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

translations.kjv: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
translations.ylt: and having removed him, He did raise up to them David for king, to whom also having testified, he said, I found David, the son of Jesse, a man according to My heart, who shall do all My will.
translations.web: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

translations.kjv: Of this man’s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
translations.ylt: `Of this one's seed God, according to promise, did raise to Israel a Saviour--Jesus,
translations.web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

translations.kjv: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
translations.ylt: John having first preached, before his coming, a baptism of reformation to all the people of Israel;
translations.web: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

translations.kjv: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
translations.ylt: and as John was fulfilling the course, he said, Whom me do ye suppose to be? I am not he, but, lo, he doth come after me, of whom I am not worthy to loose the sandal of his feet.
translations.web: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

translations.kjv: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
translations.ylt: `Men, brethren, sons of the race of Abraham, and those among you fearing God, to you was the word of this salvation sent,
translations.web: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

translations.kjv: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
translations.ylt: for those dwelling in Jerusalem, and their chiefs, this one not having known, also the voices of the prophets, which every sabbath are being read--having judged him --did fulfil,
translations.web: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

translations.kjv: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
translations.ylt: and no cause of death having found, they did ask of Pilate that he should be slain,
translations.web: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

translations.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
translations.ylt: and when they did complete all the things written about him, having taken him down from the tree, they laid him in a tomb;
translations.web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

translations.kjv: But God raised him from the dead:
translations.ylt: and God did raise him out of the dead,
translations.web: But God raised him from the dead,

translations.kjv: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
translations.ylt: and he was seen for many days of those who did come up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
translations.web: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

translations.kjv: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
translations.ylt: `And we to you do proclaim good news--that the promise made unto the fathers,
translations.web: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

translations.kjv: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
translations.ylt: God hath in full completed this to us their children, having raised up Jesus, as also in the second Psalm it hath been written, My Son thou art--I to-day have begotten thee.
translations.web: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

translations.kjv: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
translations.ylt: `And that He did raise him up out of the dead, no more to return to corruption, he hath said thus--I will give to you the faithful kindnesses of David;
translations.web: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

translations.kjv: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
translations.ylt: wherefore also in another place he saith, Thou shalt not give Thy kind One to see corruption,
translations.web: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

translations.kjv: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
translations.ylt: for David, indeed, his own generation having served by the will of God, did fall asleep, and was added unto his fathers, and saw corruption,
translations.web: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

translations.kjv: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
translations.ylt: but he whom God did raise up, did not see corruption.
translations.web: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

translations.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
translations.ylt: `Let it therefore be known to you, men, brethren, that through this one to you is the forgiveness of sins declared,
translations.web: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

translations.kjv: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
translations.ylt: and from all things from which ye were not able in the law of Moses to be declared righteous, in this one every one who is believing is declared righteous;
translations.web: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

translations.kjv: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
translations.ylt: see, therefore, it may not come upon you that hath been spoken in the prophets:
translations.web: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

translations.kjv: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
translations.ylt: See, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish, because a work I--I do work in your days, a work in which ye may not believe, though any one may declare it to you.'
translations.web: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

translations.kjv: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
translations.ylt: And having gone forth out of the synagogue of the Jews, the nations were calling upon them that on the next sabbath these sayings may be spoken to them,
translations.web: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

translations.kjv: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
translations.ylt: and the synagogue having been dismissed, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes did follow Paul and Barnabas, who, speaking to them, were persuading them to remain in the grace of God.
translations.web: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

translations.kjv: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
translations.ylt: And on the coming sabbath, almost all the city was gathered together to hear the word of God,
translations.web: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

translations.kjv: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
translations.ylt: and the Jews having seen the multitudes, were filled with zeal, and did contradict the things spoken by Paul--contradicting and speaking evil.
translations.web: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

translations.kjv: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: And speaking boldly, Paul and Barnabas said, `To you it was necessary that first the word of God be spoken, and seeing ye do thrust it away, and do not judge yourselves worthy of the life age-during, lo, we do turn to the nations;
translations.web: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

translations.kjv: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
translations.ylt: for so hath the Lord commanded us: I have set thee for a light of nations--for thy being for salvation unto the end of the earth.'
translations.web: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

translations.kjv: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
translations.ylt: And the nations hearing were glad, and were glorifying the word of the Lord, and did believe--as many as were appointed to life age-during;
translations.web: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

translations.kjv: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
translations.ylt: and the word of the Lord was spread abroad through all the region.
translations.web: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

translations.kjv: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
translations.ylt: And the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the first men of the city, and did raise persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and did put them out from their borders;
translations.web: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

translations.kjv: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
translations.ylt: and they having shaken off the dust of their feet against them, came to Iconium,
translations.web: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

translations.kjv: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: and the disciples were filled with joy and the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
translations.ylt: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they did enter together into the synagogue of the Jews, and spake, so that there believed both of Jews and Greeks a great multitude;
translations.web: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

translations.kjv: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
translations.ylt: and the unbelieving Jews did stir up and made evil the souls of the nations against the brethren;
translations.web: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

translations.kjv: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
translations.ylt: long time, indeed, therefore, did they abide speaking boldly in the Lord, who is testifying to the word of His grace, and granting signs and wonders to come to pass through their hands.
translations.web: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

translations.kjv: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
translations.ylt: And the multitude of the city was divided, and some were with the Jews, and some with the apostles,
translations.web: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

translations.kjv: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
translations.ylt: and when there was a purpose both of the nations and of the Jews with their rulers to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
translations.web: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

translations.kjv: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
translations.ylt: they having become aware, did flee to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, and Derbe, and to the region round about,
translations.web: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

translations.kjv: And there they preached the gospel.
translations.ylt: and there they were proclaiming good news.
translations.web: There they preached the Good News.

translations.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:
translations.ylt: And a certain man in Lystra, impotent in the feet, was sitting, being lame from the womb of his mother--who never had walked,
translations.web: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

translations.kjv: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
translations.ylt: this one was hearing Paul speaking, who, having stedfastly beheld him, and having seen that he hath faith to be saved,
translations.web: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

translations.kjv: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
translations.ylt: said with a loud voice, `Stand up on thy feet upright;' and he was springing and walking,
translations.web: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

translations.kjv: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
translations.ylt: and the multitudes having seen what Paul did, did lift up their voice, in the speech of Lycaonia, saying, `The gods, having become like men, did come down unto us;'
translations.web: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

translations.kjv: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
translations.ylt: they were calling also Barnabas Zeus, and Paul Hermes, since he was the leader in speaking.
translations.web: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

translations.kjv: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
translations.ylt: And the priest of the Zeus that is before their city, oxen and garlands unto the porches having brought, with the multitudes did wish to sacrifice,
translations.web: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

translations.kjv: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
translations.ylt: and having heard, the apostles Barnabas and Paul, having rent their garments, did spring into the multitude, crying
translations.web: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

translations.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
translations.ylt: and saying, `Men, why these things do ye? and we are men like-affected with you, proclaiming good news to you, from these vanities to turn unto the living God, who made the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and all the things in them;
translations.web: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

translations.kjv: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
translations.ylt: who in the past generations did suffer all the nations to go on in their ways,
translations.web: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
translations.ylt: though, indeed, without witness He did not leave himself, doing good--from heaven giving rains to us, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness;'
translations.web: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

translations.kjv: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
translations.ylt: and these things saying, scarcely did they restrain the multitudes from sacrificing to them.
translations.web: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

translations.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
translations.ylt: And there came thither, from Antioch and Iconium, Jews, and they having persuaded the multitudes, and having stoned Paul, drew him outside of the city, having supposed him to be dead;
translations.web: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

translations.kjv: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
translations.ylt: and the disciples having surrounded him, having risen he entered into the city, and on the morrow he went forth with Barnabas to Derbe.
translations.web: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

translations.kjv: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
translations.ylt: Having proclaimed good news also to that city, and having discipled many, they turned back to Lystra, and Iconium, and Antioch,
translations.web: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

translations.kjv: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
translations.ylt: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting to remain in the faith, and that through many tribulations it behoveth us to enter into the reign of God,
translations.web: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

translations.kjv: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
translations.ylt: and having appointed to them by vote elders in every assembly, having prayed with fastings, they commended them to the Lord in whom they had believed.
translations.web: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

translations.kjv: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
translations.ylt: And having passed through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia,
translations.web: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

translations.kjv: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
translations.ylt: and having spoken in Perga the word, they went down to Attalia,
translations.web: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

translations.kjv: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
translations.ylt: and thence did sail to Antioch, whence they had been given by the grace of God for the work that they fulfilled;
translations.web: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

translations.kjv: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
translations.ylt: and having come and gathered together the assembly, they declared as many things as God did with them, and that He did open to the nations a door of faith;
translations.web: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

translations.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
translations.ylt: and they abode there not a little time with the disciples.
translations.web: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

translations.kjv: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
translations.ylt: And certain having come down from Judea, were teaching the brethren--`If ye be not circumcised after the custom of Moses, ye are not able to be saved;'
translations.web: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

translations.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
translations.ylt: there having been, therefore, not a little dissension and disputation to Paul and Barnabas with them, they arranged for Paul and Barnabas, and certain others of them, to go up unto the apostles and elders to Jerusalem about this question,
translations.web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

translations.kjv: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
translations.ylt: they indeed, then, having been sent forward by the assembly, were passing through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the nations, and they were causing great joy to all the brethren.
translations.web: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

translations.kjv: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
translations.ylt: And having come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly, and the apostles, and the elders, they declared also as many things as God did with them;
translations.web: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

translations.kjv: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
translations.ylt: and there rose up certain of those of the sect of the Pharisees who believed, saying--`It behoveth to circumcise them, to command them also to keep the law of Moses.'
translations.web: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

translations.kjv: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
translations.ylt: And there were gathered together the apostles and the elders, to see about this matter,
translations.web: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

translations.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
translations.ylt: and there having been much disputing, Peter having risen up said unto them, `Men, brethren, ye know that from former days, God among us did make choice, through my mouth, for the nations to hear the word of the good news, and to believe;
translations.web: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

translations.kjv: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
translations.ylt: and the heart-knowing God did bare them testimony, having given to them the Holy Spirit, even as also to us,
translations.web: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

translations.kjv: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
translations.ylt: and did put no difference also between us and them, by the faith having purified their hearts;
translations.web: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

translations.kjv: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
translations.ylt: now, therefore, why do ye tempt God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
translations.web: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

translations.kjv: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
translations.ylt: but, through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, we believe to be saved, even as also they.'
translations.web: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

translations.kjv: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
translations.ylt: And all the multitude did keep silence, and were hearkening to Barnabas and Paul, declaring as many signs and wonders as God did among the nations through them;
translations.web: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

translations.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
translations.ylt: and after they are silent, James answered, saying, `Men, brethren, hearken to me;
translations.web: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

translations.kjv: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
translations.ylt: Simeon did declare how at first God did look after to take out of the nations a people for His name,
translations.web: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

translations.kjv: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
translations.ylt: and to this agree the words of the prophets, as it hath been written:
translations.web: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

translations.kjv: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
translations.ylt: After these things I will turn back, and I will build again the tabernacle of David, that is fallen down, and its ruins I will build again, and will set it upright--
translations.web: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

translations.kjv: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
translations.ylt: that the residue of men may seek after the Lord, and all the nations, upon whom My name hath been called, saith the Lord, who is doing all these things.
translations.web: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

translations.kjv: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
translations.ylt: `Known from the ages to God are all His works;
translations.web: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

translations.kjv: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
translations.ylt: wherefore I judge: not to trouble those who from the nations do turn back to God,
translations.web: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

translations.kjv: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
translations.ylt: but to write to them to abstain from the pollutions of the idols, and the whoredom, and the strangled thing; and the blood;
translations.web: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

translations.kjv: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
translations.ylt: for Moses from former generations in every city hath those preaching him--in the synagogues every sabbath being read.'
translations.web: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

translations.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
translations.ylt: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, chosen men out of themselves to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas--Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, leading men among the brethren--
translations.web: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

translations.kjv: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
translations.ylt: having written through their hand thus: `The apostles, and the elders, and the brethren, to those in Antioch, and Syria, and Cilicia, brethren, who are of the nations, greeting;
translations.web: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

translations.kjv: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
translations.ylt: seeing we have heard that certain having gone forth from us did trouble you with words, subverting your souls, saying to be circumcised and to keep the law, to whom we did give no charge,
translations.web: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

translations.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
translations.ylt: it seemed good to us, having come together with one accord, chosen men to send unto you, with our beloved Barnabas and Paul--
translations.web: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

translations.kjv: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ--
translations.web: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
translations.ylt: we have sent, therefore, Judas and Silas, and they by word are telling the same things.
translations.web: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

translations.kjv: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
translations.ylt: `For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, no more burden to lay upon you, except these necessary things:
translations.web: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

translations.kjv: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
translations.ylt: to abstain from things offered to idols, and blood, and a strangled thing, and whoredom; from which keeping yourselves, ye shall do well; be strong!'
translations.web: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

translations.kjv: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
translations.ylt: They then, indeed, having been let go, went to Antioch, and having brought the multitude together, did deliver the epistle,
translations.web: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

translations.kjv: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
translations.ylt: and they having read, did rejoice for the consolation;
translations.web: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

translations.kjv: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
translations.ylt: Judas also and Silas, being themselves also prophets, through much discourse did exhort the brethren, and confirm,
translations.web: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

translations.kjv: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
translations.ylt: and having passed some time, they were let go with peace from the brethren unto the apostles;
translations.web: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

translations.kjv: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
translations.ylt: And Paul and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and proclaiming good news--with many others also--the word of the Lord;
translations.web: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

translations.kjv: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
translations.ylt: and after certain days, Paul said unto Barnabas, `Having turned back again, we may look after our brethren, in every city in which we have preached the word of the Lord--how they are.'
translations.web: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

translations.kjv: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
translations.ylt: And Barnabas counselled to take with them John called Mark,
translations.web: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

translations.kjv: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
translations.ylt: and Paul was not thinking it good to take him with them who withdrew from them from Pamphylia, and did not go with them to the work;
translations.web: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

translations.kjv: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
translations.ylt: there came, therefore, a sharp contention, so that they were parted from one another, and Barnabas having taken Mark, did sail to Cyprus,
translations.web: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

translations.kjv: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
translations.ylt: and Paul having chosen Silas, went forth, having been given up to the grace of God by the brethren;
translations.web: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
